### Biography
Dr Peter Cotton a career quant, applied mathematician, open-source developer
and entrepreneur. He has a long career as a senior quantitative developer at a
score of large investment banks and hedge funds including JP Morgan and Goldman
Sachs and has more recently founded the company
[Crunch Lab](https://hub.crunchdao.com/signup) researching the implementations
and uses of decentralized AI and market model prediction.
